title: Oven Roasted Moroccan Sterbottensost Cheese Pastilla
description: A cozy Moroccan dish featuring Sterbottensost cheese, this pastilla is a perfect blend of flavors and textures, with a smoky and cold twist, making it shojin-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the crumbled Sterbottensost cheese, smoked paprika, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Layer the filo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the filo dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the filo dough over the cheese mixture to form a pastilla shape.
Brush the top of the pastilla with olive oil and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake the pastilla in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the filo dough is golden brown.
Remove the pastilla from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
